note.question: How can constrained markov decision processes with applications to queue scheduling and inventory management be represented using primal-dual?
note.overview: In many operations management problems, we need to make decisions sequentially to minimize the cost, satisfying certain constraints. One modeling approach to such problems is the constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). In this work, we develop a data-driven primal-dual algorithm to solve CMDPs.
